name: What are the common issues found during siding preparation that can increase project scope?

mainEntity.name: What are the common issues found during siding preparation that can increase project scope?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common issues discovered during siding preparation that can expand the project scope include extensive wood rot in the sheathing or structural framing, especially around windows, doors, and eaves. Mold or mildew growth due to previous moisture intrusion is also frequent. Additionally, unexpected insect damage, such as termites or carpenter ants, may be uncovered. Finally, old homes might reveal lead-based paint that requires specialized and costly abatement. These findings necessitate additional repairs, impacting both timeline and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common issues found include wood rot, mold, insect damage, or lead-based paint, which can increase project scope.
